name: PB-001: Prompt Drift Corrector
trigger_condition: Agent output deviates >15% from baseline token pattern or semantic drift detected
isolation_steps: Capture current agent system_prompt and compare to baseline
Log drift delta and affected conversation context
Pause agent task queue to prevent cascading drift
healing_steps: Flush agent context window
Reload baseline system_prompt from AegisPlaybook template
Apply context repair injection with corrected instructions
Resume agent with fresh context
verification_steps: Run test query against corrected agent
Compare output to baseline within 5% tolerance
Confirm token efficiency restored to baseline ±10%

name: PB-002: CPU Spike Throttle
trigger_condition: CPU usage exceeds 85% threshold on any OrchestratorNode
isolation_steps: Identify node with CPU spike via SystemHeartbeat
Determine which OrchestratorTask is consuming CPU
Check if spike is from training or normal load
healing_steps: Throttle non-critical background tasks on affected node
Redistribute load to alternate node with <50% CPU
Enable dynamic CPU frequency scaling
Clear process cache and optimize memory allocation
verification_steps: Confirm CPU dropped below 85% threshold
Verify redistributed tasks completed successfully
Check SystemHealth for stable overall_status

name: PB-003: Latency Spike Resolver
isolation_steps: Identify agent with elevated latency via OrchestratorAgent metrics
Trace latency to upstream dependency
Check OrchestratorNode CPU/memory for bottleneck
healing_steps: Reroute agent tasks to lower-latency node
Clear stale connection pools
Warm agent context cache
Apply fallback routing if upstream bottleneck
verification_steps: Confirm agent latency returned to <2x baseline
Verify no tasks dropped during reroute
Log healing event with before/after metrics

name: PB-004: Token Overrun Optimizer
trigger_condition: Agent token usage exceeds 150% of expected token budget per task
isolation_steps: Identify agent with token overrun via OrchestratorTask records
Analyze token distribution (prompt vs completion vs context)
Check for prompt bloat or redundant context injection
healing_steps: Apply token budget enforcement with hard cap
Strip non-essential context from agent prompt
Compress system_prompt to essential directives only
Enable context summarization for long conversations
verification_steps: Confirm token usage within 110% of budget
Verify agent output quality maintained
Log token savings as LearningMetric

name: PB-005: Orphan Node Purger
trigger_condition: OrchestratorNode with zero active OrchestratorTask records and last_active_at exceeds stale threshold
isolation_steps: Confirm node has zero active tasks via OrchestratorTask query
Verify last_active_at exceeds stale threshold (default 24h)
Check no pending tasks assigned to this node
Mark node as is_orphan=true
healing_steps: Drain any remaining idle connections on orphaned node
Delete OrchestratorNode record
Log purge in AegisHealingEvent
Update SystemHealth orphan_node_count
verification_steps: Confirm node record deleted
Verify no tasks orphaned by deletion
Confirm SystemHealth reflects reduced orphan count

name: PB-006: Agent Overload Balancer
isolation_steps: Identify overloaded agent via OrchestratorAgent load metrics
Find underutilized agents with <40% load capacity
Calculate optimal task redistribution plan
healing_steps: Reroute incoming tasks from overloaded to underutilized agents
Update current_task_count on all affected agents
Refresh OrchestratorNode assignments
Confirm heartbeat health post-rebalance
verification_steps: Confirm all agents below 70% load threshold
Verify no tasks dropped during redistribution
Log rebalance as AegisHealingEvent

name: PB-007: Export Pipeline Restorer
trigger_condition: Export telemetry shows transfer failure, formatting drop, or auth timeout
isolation_steps: Check export pipeline auth token validity
Identify failed export batch and target document
Determine failure type: auth_timeout, format_mismatch, rate_limit
healing_steps: Refresh OAuth token for export pipeline
Retry failed export with exponential backoff (3 attempts max)
Normalize payload to expected schema if format mismatch
Queue export for next available window if rate limited
verification_steps: Confirm export completed successfully on retry
Verify document formatting matches expected schema
Log pipeline restore in AegisHealingEvent

name: PB-008: Heartbeat Re-igniter
trigger_condition: SystemHeartbeat record missing for any registered component beyond expected interval
isolation_steps: Identify component with missing heartbeat
Check if component still registered in OrchestratorAgent/Node
Determine if component crashed or monitoring loop stopped
healing_steps: Re-invoke ameliaHeartbeat for affected component
Restart via agentActivation if component crashed
Restart heartbeat cron if monitoring loop stopped
Register fresh SystemHeartbeat record
verification_steps: Confirm new heartbeat record created
Verify component status is 'alive' in SystemHeartbeat
Log re-ignition in AegisHealingEvent

name: PB-009: Quantum Vulnerability Migrator
trigger_condition: pqcManager detects legacy cryptographic algorithm (RSA, ECC, DH) in inter-agent comms or system config
isolation_steps: Identify vulnerable algorithm and affected component via AegisAnomaly
Determine threat level and estimated break year
Check if PQC replacement algorithm is available (Kyber, Dilithium, SPHINCS+)
Flag as critical if in active fintech transaction path
healing_steps: Migrate vulnerable algorithm to NIST-approved PQC alternative
Update affected component configuration
Verify hybrid scheme for backward compatibility
Mark anomaly as resolved with migration log
verification_steps: Confirm pqcManager validation passes post-migration
Verify zero vulnerable_crypto_count in SystemHealth
Log migration in AegisHealingEvent with before/after algorithms

name: PB-010: Unknown Anomaly Escalator
trigger_condition: Anomaly detected that does not match any known anomaly_type
isolation_steps: Capture full anomaly context (agent, node, metrics, timestamp)
Search Pattern and AegisHealingEvent history for similar signatures
Classify as 'unknown' if no match found
healing_steps: Create SelfImprovementProposal for new anomaly type
Generate PredictiveAlert with severity based on impact assessment
Escalate to human operator via Slack #squirrel-os-alerts
Set anomaly status to 'escalated'
verification_steps: Confirm SelfImprovementProposal created
Verify PredictiveAlert posted
Confirm escalation notification sent
